message.en: Confirm passport/visa or domestic ID requirements for China travel.
message.zh: 确认中国行程证件要求：境内居民带好身份证；入境旅客核验签证/过境免签政策。

title.zh: 核验入境证件或身份证

message.en: WeChat Pay / Alipay are default; prepare mobile payments or UnionPay backup.
message.zh: 微信/支付宝为默认支付；外卡场景有限，请提前开通移动支付或备银联卡/少量现金。

title.en: Set up WeChat Pay or Alipay
title.zh: 开通微信支付或支付宝

message.en: Book popular attractions and trains early around National Day / summer / Spring Festival.
message.zh: 国庆、暑期、春节等高峰请提前预约热门景区门票与高铁票。

title.en: Reserve timed-entry tickets for major sites
title.zh: 预约主要景区分时门票

message.en: Check local plate/odd-even driving limits and expressway ETC before city self-drive. See data/country-packs/CN/city-driving-limits.v1.json for major-city hints (not real-time).
message.zh: 进城自驾前核验当地尾号/环保限行与高速公路 ETC。主要城市提示见 data/country-packs/CN/city-driving-limits.v1.json（非实时，以交管通告为准）。

message.en: For Tibet / western Sichuan / Qinghai routes, apply altitude acclimatization and CN_XIZANG/CN_SICHUAN pack thresholds.
message.zh: 涉藏、川西、青海等高海拔行程须安排适应期，并套用 CN_XIZANG / CN_SICHUAN 风险阈值。

message.en: Pack for regional climate extremes (humid heat south / cold dry north / monsoon).
message.zh: 按区域气候备装：南方湿热、北方干冷、季风暴雨与高原昼夜温差。

message.en: Ensure medical coverage for domestic long-haul / adventure segments; foreigners confirm travel insurance.
message.zh: 长途自驾或户外段建议确认医疗保障；入境旅客确认旅行保险覆盖中国大陆。

message.en: Plan mobile data / eSIM; many services assume mainland connectivity and apps.
message.zh: 规划大陆手机流量/eSIM；地图、购票与支付高度依赖本地网络与 App。

items.zh: 护照或中国居民身份证

items.en: Visa / transit visa-free eligibility (if foreign visitor)
items.zh: 签证或过境免签资格（入境旅客）

items.en: UnionPay card or small cash backup
items.zh: 银联卡或少量现金备用
有效驾照（及国际驾照如需）

items.en: City driving-limit check for destination dates

items.zh: ETC 或通行费支付方式

items.en: If on classic routes (G318 / G211 / Qinggan loop etc.), apply route pack hints
items.zh: 若走经典线（G318/G211/青甘大环线等），套用 classic-self-drive-routes 提示

items.en: Altitude plan if visiting plateau regions
items.zh: 高原行程适应计划（如适用）

summary.en: High-altitude regions (Tibet / western Sichuan / Qinghai): altitude sickness risk; acclimatize and avoid rapid ascent.
summary.zh: 高海拔地区（西藏/川西/青海）：存在高原反应风险；需适应并避免快速攀升。

mitigations.en: Schedule acclimatization days; apply CN_XIZANG / CN_SICHUAN thresholds.
mitigations.zh: 安排适应日；套用 CN_XIZANG / CN_SICHUAN 阈值。

summary.en: Holiday crowding & transport strain around National Day / Spring Festival / summer.
summary.zh: 国庆/春节/暑期高峰易拥堵且票务紧张。

mitigations.en: Book timed tickets and transport early; prefer shoulder-season alternatives.
mitigations.zh: 提前预约分时门票与交通；优先错峰替代方案。
